overview: SheGuide is an integration super-app for international women in Germany, helping them navigate bureaucracy, find peer support, understand their rights, and settle into professional life with confidence.
features: She Buddy peer matching network connecting newcomers with volunteer mentors
Smart bureaucracy deadline tracker personalized by visa type and arrival date
AI-powered German form pre-filler storing user profile once for all official forms
Rights awareness Q&A tool identifying AGG violations and connecting to legal aid
3-stage integration journey: Arrival & Immigration, Settling In, Professional Integration
Teal/green branded dashboard with sidebar navigation
